name: Chicken à la King
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 3½ ounces (100 g) chopped pimentos or other mild chile peppers
13½–14½ US fl. oz. (400–430 ml) chicken broth (depending on the size of can or jar available in your area)

steps: Season the chicken breasts with salt, pepper and garlic powder and then cube them into bite-size pieces.
Sauté the chicken cubes, onion, mushrooms, and pimentos in the olive oil in a skillet.
In a saucepan, melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook over medium heat for about a minute.
Add the chicken broth and stir till thickened.
Add the sauce to the chicken and vegetable mixture; stir together and cook a few more minutes.
Serve over biscuits, toast or toasted English muffins.

culture.text: Chicken à la King is an American dish consisting of diced, shredded, or sliced chicken in a cream sauce, usually with mushrooms, pimientos, and sherry, originally served over toast points or in a vol-au-vent or pastry case, later over rice or noodles. Variations include tuna, turkey, etc., à la King.
